market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a hawkish Fed surprise risk vs. energy-driven inflation. S&P 500 likely range-bound $5,800-$6,100 as jobs data keeps hike bets alive. Oil above $95 sustains inflation pressure. Dollar weakness supports EM and crypto but pressures USD exporters. Expect elevated volatility into September FOMC.
market_outlook.long_term: Energy supply constraints from dual wars create a structural inflation floor, supporting energy equities and TIPS. AI capex cycle (GPT-6, Nvidia consolidation) drives 12-month tech outperformance but raises bubble risk. Sovereign fund rotation away from US Treasuries signals gradual de-dollarization trend. Consumer spending remains vulnerable to energy pass-through. 6-12 month: moderate growth, elevated inflation, higher-for-longer rates.
